{"code": "import numpy as np

# Check for missing values in the two columns of interest
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isnull().sum()
missing_body_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isnull().sum()

# Drop rows with missing values in either column
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the number of rows after dropping
n_rows_clean = len(penguins_clean)

# Compute Pearson correlation
pearson_corr = penguins_clean['flipper_length_mm'].corr(penguins_clean['body_mass_g'])

# Print results
missing_flipper, missing_body_mass, n_rows_clean, pearson_corr"}
